patch_description: The local search has plateaued at min_area_normalized ~0.02, indicating the two reheat cycles that always restart from the single global best are simply re-exploring the same basin. The cheapest structural fix is a pool-based restart scheme: keep the top-3 distinct configurations found across all seeds (diversity enforced by requiring pairwise point-set distance > 0.1), then run one reheat annealing cycle from each pool member plus one from the global best. This explores multiple good basins instead of repeatedly perturbing the same one, while keeping determinism (fixed seed governs pool selection order) and roughly the same runtime budget by shortening each reheat cycle slightly to accommodate the extra restarts.
